note: Scripture follows the Open Luganda Contemporary Bible (OLCB 2017, lug_bib), spliced by script from the whole parsed Bible. Every `mined` row was checked mechanically: its wording is a verbatim (case-insensitive) substring of the OLCB verse AND present in the chapter body. `self_rendered` rows are re-personed fragments, unquoted allusions and wording OLCB does not carry (each with a `why`).

This English edition is a modernised re-edition that quotes the ESV in places (chs 7, 8, 19, 20) and carries many broken quotation marks and mislabelled references; those are listed in the PR body. Quotations follow OLCB, never the English wording.
Translated by eleven range translators in one session; chapter titles and key terms pinned centrally; tag sequence identical to the English chapter by chapter. AI-translated; awaiting native review.
